# A ride interrupted by roadworks

The usual canal entrance is closed. The diversion starts with a flight of steps and a painted bicycle symbol. I could carry the bike; a tricycle rider turned back. Added a photograph to [[Routes]] rather than simply marking the path closed. A route can be technically open and practically absent for the people who need it most.
